cookpot:coffee: Increases movement speed by 50% for 480 seconds. Also grants 10 sleep resistance.
cookpot:sharkfinsoup: After eating, attempts to spawn one Krampus at a nearby valid location. Nothing spawns if no valid location is found.
cookpot:tropicalbouillabaisse: Increases movement speed by 50% for 480 seconds. Also grants 10 sleep resistance.
cookpot:snakebonesoup: Increases damage dealt to worms and Worm Boss body segments by 50% for 720 seconds.
cookpot:gorge_garlicbread: Every 10 seconds, makes Batilisks within a radius of 10 stop attacking. Batilisks that can panic will panic for 6 seconds. Lasts 480 seconds.
cookpot:gorge_candy: Speeds up picking, harvesting, taking items, dismantling, and ordinary crafting actions for 480 seconds.
cookpot:cucumbersalad: Removes wetness and keeps you dry for 300 seconds.
cookpot:bowlofgears: Only WX-78 can eat this: immediately restores 100 charge.
cookpot:duckyouglermz: Only Wormwood can eat this: grants 3 Bloom fertility and restores an additional 60 health.
cookpot:eyeballspaghetti: After eating, attempts to spawn one Deerclops about 40 units away. Nothing spawns if a Deerclops already exists in the world or no valid location is found.
cookpot:soulstew: Only Wortox can eat this: hunger +150. With a kind inclination: health +30, sanity -25; with a naughty inclination: health +15, sanity +25; with any other inclination: health +30, sanity -15.
cookpot:fortunecookie: Each time it is eaten, there is a 5% chance to trigger a special fate. If triggered, the base chance of good fortune is 33%: health, hunger, and sanity each increase by 9,999, subject to their limits. Otherwise, bad fortune sets health to 20% and removes 9,999 hunger and sanity. Luck affects the chance of the good outcome. If no special fate triggers, it only gives a fortune message.
cookpot:honeyjar: Bees will not target you on their own for 720 seconds. Harvesting a regular Bee Box does not alert the bees and restores an additional 2 sanity.
cookpot:watercup: Immediately removes buffs and debuffs that can be cleared. It does not remove Food Healing Sickness or Wortox's pan flute buff, and it cannot undo damage or summons that already occurred.
cookpot:poisonfrogglebunwich: Makes you immune to frog aggression for 480 seconds.
cookpot:gummybeargers: If the giant-summoning option is enabled, eating this attempts to spawn one Bearger about 40 units away. Nothing spawns if a Bearger already exists in the world or no valid location is found.
cookpot:gummyworms: Grants night vision for 480 seconds and raises grogginess to at least 1.5.
cookpot:sea_pudding: Whenever you catch a fish, gain one extra fish of the same kind, with a base 33% chance to gain another. Lasts 720 seconds. Luck affects the extra chance when fishing in ponds.
cookpot:parznip_soup: Uses the fast eating action for 720 seconds.
cookpot:livingsandwich: Felling a supported, unburned tree yields extra wood according to its species and growth stage. For example, small, medium, and large Evergreens yield 1, 2, and 3 extra Logs respectively. Lasts 480 seconds, or 960 seconds for Woodie. Eating it also forces Woodie to transform into a Werebeaver.
cookpot:lunarsoup: Clears grogginess and grants 10 sleep resistance. Prevents sanity loss from sanity auras, darkness, and player ghosts, and negates sanity effects from magical equipment. Lasts 480 seconds.
cookpot:crabkingfeast: Increases damage dealt to the Crab King, its allies, and creatures with the crab tag by 50% for 720 seconds.
cookpot:trufflesgrinder: For 240 seconds, recruits nearby unowned Pig Men within a radius of 12 every second while you have fewer than 10 followers, and adds 3 seconds of loyalty to existing Pig Man followers. Does not work for Merm or monster characters.
cookpot:sporecappie: Grants immunity to spore poison clouds, but directly carried perishable food spoils 1.5 times as fast, for 480 seconds. Monster characters also recover an additional 20 health and 10 sanity when eating it, except during Food Healing Sickness.
cookpot:sporecap_skewers: Grants immunity to acid rain, but directly carried perishable food spoils 1.5 times as fast, for 480 seconds. Monster characters also recover an additional 30 health and 20 sanity when eating it, except during Food Healing Sickness.
cookpot:monkeyislandmeal: Immediately removes up to 999 stacks of cursed trinkets.
cookpot:brainmettersoup: When crafting an item that can go into a container, there is a base 10% chance to create one extra copy for 240 seconds. Luck affects the chance, up to a 50% maximum. Shop, trade, and Hermit Crab exchange recipes are excluded.
cookpot:chickenwings: Increases attack damage by 30%, but also increases ordinary damage taken by 35%, for 480 seconds.
cookpot:chickenrotisserie: Reduces natural hunger drain by 25% for 480 seconds.
cookpot:cavetubertea: Picking a supported plant duplicates its harvest, including the stack size. Using a harvest action instead gives one extra item. Lasts 480 seconds. Giant crops and plants on the exclusion list do not qualify.
cookpot:mandrakepie: Attempts to put eligible creatures within a radius of 20 to sleep, using a 10-second sleep duration parameter. Adds 7 drowsiness to creatures and 4 grogginess to players. Actual sleep depends on resistance; frozen, trapped, or petrified targets are excluded.
cookpot:rainparfait: While it is raining or your wetness is at least 50, restores 1 sanity every 10 seconds. Lasts 480 seconds. Does not restore sanity during Food Healing Sickness.
cookpot:midnightfeast: For 480 seconds, each hit at night has a 20% chance to instantly kill an eligible target. Players, bosses, domesticated creatures, and designated companions such as Chester, Hutch, and Packim are excluded.
cookpot:opalpreciouscream: Has a base 10% chance to deal 2.5 times normal damage (an extra 150%) for 480 seconds. Luck affects the critical-hit chance, up to a 40% maximum.
cookpot:jawsbreaker: Can be thrown into the ocean as bait to lure Rockjaw Sharks within about 15 units. Kills a shark about 1 second after it eats the bait. It is also fatal to a Gnarwail that eats it.
cookpot:sharksushi: After eating, attempts to spawn one Krampus at a nearby valid location. Nothing spawns if no valid location is found.
warly:bubbletea: Clears current grogginess and grants 10 sleep resistance for 480 seconds.
warly:jellybean_sanity: Restores 2 sanity every 2 seconds for 120 seconds. Does not restore sanity during Food Healing Sickness.
warly:jellybean_hunger: Restores 2 hunger every 2 seconds for 120 seconds.
warly:jellybean_super: Restores 2 health, 2 hunger, and 2 sanity every 2 seconds for 120 seconds. During Food Healing Sickness, only hunger is restored.
warly:berrysundae: Grants 120 insulation against heat for 240 seconds.
warly:milkshake_prismatic: Makes your body glow in shifting colors, illuminating nearby areas for 240 seconds.
warly:tom_kha_soup: Grants 120 insulation against cold for 240 seconds.
warly:warlytea: Provides an additional 0.75 sanity per second for 240 seconds.
warly:lazydessert: Can be offered to the Antlion to delay its anger by 2,880 seconds (six in-game days).
warly:lavaeeggboiled: Reduces the fire-damage multiplier to zero for 960 seconds. Willow retains her own fire resistance.
warly:tiramisu: Increases movement speed by 50% for 480 seconds. Also removes wetness and keeps you dry for 300 seconds.
warly:mandrakebaobuns: Each qualifying positive heal restores an additional 15 health for 480 seconds. Healing without a source tag, ongoing healing from Jellybeans, and life steal by Wigfrid or the Shadow Maul do not trigger this effect.
warly:bbqribs: Replaces knockback with a shorter landing knockback action for 480 seconds.
warly:swordfishbluedinner: For 480 seconds, hitting the same target three times in a row triggers an ice wave with a radius of about 3 units, dealing 30 base damage to nearby eligible enemies. The primary target takes no damage from the wave. The count resets after a gap of more than 4 seconds or a change of target. The trigger has a 0.3-second cooldown.
warly:opalpreciouslollipop: Randomly grants one buff or debuff from its effect list; its strength and duration depend on the result. Eating another replaces the previous result. There is also a base 1% chance of instant death, modified by luck; a gambling-death-immunity tag prevents this death check.

keg:paleale: Increases attack damage by 50% and reduces movement speed by 30% for 520 seconds.
keg:mead: Reduces ordinary damage taken by one-third (about 33.3%) and reduces movement speed by 30% for 480 seconds.
keg:ricesake: Reduces ordinary damage taken by one-third (about 33.3%) and reduces movement speed by 30% for 480 seconds.
